tools.name: check_before_install
tools.description: Evidence summary for an MCP server before you install or connect it: publisher identity level, provenance, known vulnerabilities, install scripts, maintenance, open warnings, checks that could not run, and recent changes. No warnings is NOT a safety guarantee.

tools.name: get_setup
tools.description: One stable answer (schema_version 1) for connecting an MCP server: its validated remote URL and transport, packages, copy-paste setup for Claude Code and JSON configs, warnings by severity, checks that could not run, and contradicted claims. auth is null until Assay has checked the sign-in metadata

tools.name: resolve_identifier
tools.description: Resolve an MCP server name, catalog id or GitHub repository URL to the real registry entry. If there is no exact match, returns the closest real names so look-alikes and invented names can be caught. No account needed.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search cataloged MCP servers by keywords. Returns classification (verified_publisher = the publisher proved control of a domain or verified GitHub org, NOT that a company named in the tool made it / community / not_analyzed), identity level and warning counts.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Every assertion for a tool with its state (VERIFIED, CLAIMED, CONTRADICTED, STALE, UNKNOWN), reason, check and evidence records.

tools.name: get_publisher
tools.description: How a publisher is identified across ecosystems (MCP namespace, domain, GitHub, packages) and the state of each link.

tools.name: get_changes
tools.description: Metadata changes between consecutive published versions: new network hosts, replaced or added artifact sources, newly requested credentials.

tools.name: get_evidence
tools.description: A single assertion of a tool (by field name) with the evidence records behind it: URL, fetch time, SHA-256.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_changes" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Metadata changes between consecutive published versions: new network hosts, replaced or added artifact sources, newly requested credentials.
